final.section_notes:
Adversarial re-check. I confirmed the central fact with grep -w against unit_image_mapping.csv, unmapped_entries.csv and mod_coverage.csv: 0 matches for all 14 named ids plus bio_mf_orca. The 9 mods are in mods-source and _export-manifest.csv but have 0 hits in data/mod-catalog.json and load-order.tokens.txt. 3843501029 and 3843495110 exist only in the 23 Nov GPT capture folder, and 3829404451 appears nowhere in the repo. The ini-derived ids are all confirmed, including the 13 bio_mf_* ids and the five plaaf_* aircraft.

Verdict changes:
- Mi-6: pin_exact to pin_class_photo. The operator, the Mi-6A configuration and whether it is a photo or a painting are all unverified.
- Be-12: pin_exact to pin_class_photo. The 'Monino ex-AV-MF' history was Gemini's unsourced claim restated as fact.
- YL-2: pin_class_photo to context_only. The main file may be a drawing, the alt may be an airshow exhibit, and there is no licence.
- WZ-10: pin_exact to pin_class_photo. The alt's own title mixes the export WL-10 and the PLA WZ-10.
- Sardine: pin_exact to context_only. It is a single specimen, not a school.

Reasoning corrections:
- 'WJ-25 CCA' is the mod's own display name ([plaaf_53536_cca] Default=WJ-25 CCA), not a Gemini-invented id.
- UndE 23's MAN HX77 is stated in the mod's own _info.ini, so it is not a Gemini error.
- Tridon Mk2 really uses the Bofors 40 Mk4 gun (per its _info.ini), so the naval-gun photo is a same-weapon component image. It is still rejected (PNG, two authors, no truck shown).
- Echidna's sensors.ini does label its values fictional.
- Removed the unverifiable claim that 'Infinty 0' is a known CC BY-SA uploader.

Data inconsistency: civ_humpback is exact_class_photo in unit_image_mapping.csv (images/ships/humpback_commons.jpg) but still photo_gap in unmapped_entries.csv. commons-photos.csv names the file humpback.jpg. Reconcile this before reusing it for bio_mf_humpback_whale_alt.

Rule applied: no licence or file existence can be verified offline, so every non-render row still needs the PC licence and identity check. Verdicts here reflect subject and variant fit only. Rows with no stated licence (YL-2, UndE 23, RBS 15 KA, Giraffe 4A, bottlenose, sardine) cannot ship until one is found. No pin can be applied until these mods are catalogued and the mapping is regenerated.

Confirmed Meshy AI content: the RBS 15 KA launchers (CREDITS.txt and the unit inis) and the Giraffe 4A radar module (CREDITS.txt). This affects how faithful the renders are, not the photo rules.

Confirmed Gemini errors: the wrong Tridon id; the non-existent 'Mt.KL'; the Be-12 '1995' end date and the missing Vietnamese operator; the blue whale; the group-only fauna credits; the Finnish MTO-85M offered without caveat; the naval antenna offered for a land unit; and a non-Commons, unlicensed Defence AU source.

final.section_notes:
Adversarial re-check of the 41 SHIPS rows. I re-checked every unit id against integration/dist/SEST_Integration/Gallery/data/unit_image_mapping.csv; all ids marked found exist, with the mapping_status shown. I also read each mod's language_en/vessel_names.ini under mods-source/ for the variant lists.

Verdicts changed:
1. usn_ddg_arleigh_burke_flight3_HELIOS: context_only to render_only. The fit is notional, so it is treated like the Kirov improved and Ulyanovsk rows.
2. wp_rkr_admiral_nakhimov_refit: pin_class_photo to context_only. The pin rested on the Kalinin 1991 alternative, which has no stated licence and shows the pre-refit missile fit. Neither file shows the 2025 configuration.

Reasons corrected (verdicts unchanged). The language files show several 'sister' photos are actually named variants of the unit:
- wp_rkr_slavaLU's only variant is Marshal Ustinov, so the Ustinov MOD photo is exact if taken after the 2016 refit. wp_rkr_slavaLV is Varyag, so it gets a class photo.
- Gyeongbuk FF-956 is Variant5 of ko_ff-951.
- Seoul FFG-821 is Variant3 of ko_ffg-818.
- Sinseong PCC-783 is Variant23 of ko_pcc-756.
- Caio Duilio is Variant2 of mm_cgh_andrea_doria (but she was in training-ship configuration in 1985).
- Carabiniere F581 is Variant2 of mm_ff_alpino.
- Nanhai PTG-772 is Variant3 of plan_ptg_type037IIE.
- HMS Amazon F169 is Variant1 of type_21+ACSL_lynx.
- wp_bpk_karaL's only variant is Kerch.
- HMS Leander F109 is Variant1 of rn_ff_leander_batch1 (converted Jan 1973), confirming the 1977 photo is exact there.

One earlier claim was wrong: that the RN 'rarely took part in RIMPAC' in the 1980s. The Global 86 group, with HMS Amazon in it, did take part in RIMPAC 86, so the title is plausible.

The ae_lpd_galicia 'L50' comes from the mod's Default line. Its Variant1 is L51 Galicia.

The 'Ulsan Class FFX-Batch-III' file stays rejected, but only until the PC check: 'Ulsan class' is the FFX programme name, so the file could be a real Chungnam-class photo rather than a render.

Repo data issues found (no files were edited):
- commons-photos.csv credits type071.jpg (File:PLANS Changbai Mountain (LPD-989) 20150825.jpg) as 'RIA Novosti archive, image # / CC-BY-SA 3.0'. That wording looks like a mis-scraped template, so the licence needs a recheck.
- commons-photos.csv keys liaoning.jpg to unit id plan_cv16_liaoning, which does not exist in unit_image_mapping.csv. The real unit, plan_type_001, is mapped as context_reference even though the photo shows the exact ship.

Gemini error patterns stand as the first audit listed them:
- Case errors.
- Underscore written for a hyphen.
- Invented ids: type_21_acsl_lynx, narco_speedboat, pkm_211, plan_type_052d_p2.
- Dropped prefixes.
- Undercounts: Saronic is 7 ids, Clemenceau is 8.

Truncated titles that cannot be fetched until resolved: Adelaide/Sydney, Bartolomeu Dias, Seoul FFG-821 and Sinsung.

Files dated near or after my knowledge, so unconfirmable: Luohe 20260519, Tamandaré 2026, the Saronic DVIDS set.

Nothing could be checked against Commons from this machine. Every file's existence, every licence and every 'is a photograph' claim is unverified and must pass the fetch_images.py licence gate on the PC.

Adversarial re-check against /home/user/sest-storms. I resolved the ids in unit_image_mapping.csv and checked the assets in commons-photos.csv, profiles.tsv, PHOTO_CREDITS.txt, PINNED_VERIFIED_FILE_PAGES.csv, curated_sources.tsv and commons-review-20261015.csv. Commons was unreachable, so no file's existence, licence or author is verified, and every Gemini file still needs the PC licence gate.

1. wp_ss_kilo_877v: pin_exact changed to pin_class_photo. 'Ab podlodka.jpg' names no boat, so nothing shows that it is B-871 Alrosa, the only 877V.

final.summary:
I re-checked the prior review against the repo and it largely holds up. I reproduced every figure: mod_coverage.csv (2026-10-09) gives 190 mods, 3,927 defs, 2,003 mapped and 1,924 unmapped. unit_image_mapping.csv (2026-10-15) gives 3,987 defs, 1,929 photo_gap and 2,058 mapped. unmapped_entries.csv has 1,927 rows, and the two files mismatch by 21 and 23 rows (the 23 are all SEST Integration Pack). catalogue.js contains 3987 and 1954. Alias rows total 120, labelled-fictional gap rows total 37 (30 RSA + 7 RADF), the catalogue has 212 mods, 22 of them are missing from coverage (15 active, 7 unsubscribed), and 5 coverage mods are no longer in the load order.

Corrections:
- The mapping_note is not a single boilerplate sentence. One sentence appears on 1,924 unmapped rows; the other 3 add a note that they are carried by the SEST pack since 3514484654 left the Workshop.
- The load order has 201 tokens: 200 workshop ids plus SEST_Integration.
- 3637954857 appears in mod_coverage under the title 'KJ-500'.
- I dropped the unchecked figures (the per-mod .ini counts and the '130 or more new defs' estimate).
- I softened 'zero-def set is 15' to 'probably 15', because the six utility mods' def counts are not computed.
- The S-300PMU2 evidence now cites the catalogue's load_order field rather than a paraphrase.

The upstream-status verdicts all stand: Fujian, S-70B-2 and the P-8 title are correct. Zyetseth is fictional but active, not retired. 'Anchor Chain replaced by Keel' is unverifiable offline. The two 'merged into REDFOR' claims are only overlaps. In the runbook, process_gallery_batch.py does not exist, and the other three tools and their flags do.

Adversarial re-check: I could not refute any of the prior audit's verdicts. I re-resolved the ids against unit_image_mapping.csv (3,987 data rows) and the mod inis, and they hold.
- Every spot-checked id exists with the label, mod and status claimed. This includes the Zyetseth row, whose unit_id really is the literal file name 'Project 2498 Zyetseth Class Assault Vessel', next to civ_fv_okean_surprise, both photo_gap.
- The 54 Fict-labelled rows are confirmed: 37 photo_gap (30 RSA + 7 RADF) and 17 already mapped (13 RSA + 3 RADF + 1 German).
- mod-catalog.json has 3399699218 as status 'active', so Gemini's 'retired' is wrong.
- The Sui/Tang swap is confirmed: the gallery says 'Type 096 Sui-class', 'Type 095 Tang-class' and 'Type 09X Tang II-class'. The 3594891803 vessel_names.ini says 095 = Sui, 09X = Sui II and 096 = Tang.
- fetch_images.py line 98 BAD_NAME has \brender\b and no 'artist' or 'rendering' term, so both Gemini rendering filenames pass the filter. This is confirmed by reading the regex.
- The A-6G ini really says 'in active service'.
- The Van Galen ini has Variant1=Van Galen F-806 and also a separate Variant7=Van Galen F-834 (line 26, the historical Karel Doorman-class name). That reinforces the search-trap point.

Changes I made:
- (a) Constellation/Columbia row: from my own knowledge, the Constellation programme was cut back in late 2025 to the first two hulls. 'Under construction, not commissioned' is still right, but the class will not reach its planned size. The Columbia delivery has slipped. Both are offline-unverifiable nuances.
- (b) Van Galen row: I added the repo evidence of the F-834 variant.
- (c) Sui/Tang row: I named the exact labels in the ini.
- (d) Zyetseth row: I confirmed the literal-filename unit_id.

All other rows are unchanged. Commons file existence and licences, the Steam retirement status, and ASWF hull status remain unverifiable offline.

From my own knowledge, the Constellation programme was cut back in late 2025 to the first two hulls, and Columbia's lead-boat delivery has slipped. Artist renderings are not photographs and break the owner's rule. fetch_images.py line 98 BAD_NAME has '\brender\b' and no 'rendering' or 'artist' term, so neither filename is filtered. The FFG(X) 2020 rendering shows the pre-Constellation design. The file names cannot be verified offline, and the VIRINs are inconsistent ('N-NO101' with a letter O versus 'N-N0101' with a zero).
findings.action: Use in-game renders, or genuine construction photos labelled 'under construction'. Add 'rendering|artist|concept' to BAD_NAME.
